phrases.latin: Baba, in sellā sedēns, pilam puerō pede impellit; puer eam pede pulsat, ut potest
phrases.english: Baba, sitting on a chair, pushes the ball to the boy with her foot; the boy kicks it as best he can

sources: Lewis & Short: ico
